synthesis.title: The Granularity Triad: DNA Ideas, Certified Revisions, and Narrative Spines
synthesis.narrative_context: Decouples atomic semantic meaning from narrative sequence. An idea is an invariant concept with multiple certified revisions, while a spine provides the linear sequential structure.
synthesis.review_notes: Inaugural VIBE card formalizing the mental model of knowledge granularity.

origin.text: Loops birth complexity. The simplest non-linear equation, like the Logistic Map, generates infinite fractal depth from trivial feedback. In systems architecture and agent swarms, complexity is not built by adding code—it emerges spontaneously when outputs are looped back as inputs with back-pressure.

synthesis.title: Feedback Loops as Complexity Engines

synthesis.review_notes: VIBE card establishing feedback loops as complexity drivers.

theme: Emergent Knowledge Affinity & Manuscript Working Groups

origin.author: jallred
origin.text: A collection of ideas, newly added DNA in collections not yet named or named during import... Writing or paper group = kabal. Ideas in caucus conspiring together before formal taxonomy.

synthesis.title: The Kabal: Emergent Idea Affinity Clusters and Manuscript Working Conspiracies
synthesis.narrative_context: Establishes 'Kabal' as the emergent middle-tier grouping between atomic DNA cards/gems and formal named collections or finished manuscripts. In import, an Ingestion Kabal captures an unbaptized cluster of co-occurring ideas with implicit affinity. In Applied Writer, a Paper Kabal acts as a caucus of citations, operational errata, and arguments conspiring to prove a central thesis.
synthesis.review_notes: Formalizes Kabal as the emergent affinity unit across ingestion and paper writing.

origin.text: Paper trail: saving copies of words with citations that allow an audit and trace of the evolution of dynamic prose writing.

synthesis.title: The Paper Trail: Word Copying, Citation Anchors, and Auditable Prose Evolution
synthesis.narrative_context: Establishes the paper trail law in manuscript composition. Rather than relying on fragile single-pointer indirections that break when external sources change or disconnect, prose is duplicated with explicit citation anchors back to the source DNA. Git diffs and text stamps create an auditable, verifiable paper trail tracking the exact evolution of dynamic writing across revisions and renames.
synthesis.review_notes: Formalizes the paper trail concept where prose is copied alongside citations to create a Git-auditable history.

theme: Parallel Thought Dynamics & Forked KV Cognition

origin.author: jallred
origin.text: Parallel thinking, KV-cache forking, and what thinking actually is. Beyond linear token streams, human cognition runs simultaneous speculative hypotheses. We explore parallel thought execution—forking shared KV-caches into multi-track deliberation before collation, transcending linear Chain-of-Thought tunnel vision.
origin.source: Sprint 108 Epistemic Deliberation & Frontier Research Synthesis

synthesis.title: Parallel Thinking, KV-Cache Forking, and What Thinking Actually Is
synthesis.narrative_context: Linear autoregressive token generation (`<think>...</think>`) is only the first, primitive stage of artificial reasoning, prone to single-track tunnel vision. True cognition is multi-track. By leveraging GPU batch-tensor parallelism and Zero-Copy prefix KV-cache branching (RadixAttention / PagedAttention), an intelligence engine forks multiple divergent reasoning hypotheses in parallel from a common stem, exploring orthogonal analytical dimensions before collating consensus into a final stance.
synthesis.review_notes: Formalizes VIBE-018: multi-track parallel thinking and KV-cache forking over linear token tunnel vision.
